title: The induction step for lifting Popescu resolutions.
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring, $A$ a finitely presented $R$-algebra, $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra, $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra map and $q$ a prime of $\Lambda$. Resolution and strict standardness mean [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution] and [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element]. For a list $\pi$ indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(r)$, require all elements to map into $q$, multiplication by $\pi_i$ and $\pi_i^2$ to have equal kernels on $R$ and $\Lambda$ modulo preceding eighth powers, and all images in $A$ to be strictly standard. The final quotient map commutes with $\alpha$ and its prime pulls back to $q$. Let $n\ge1$, $r=n+1$, and assume $P(n)$ of [def-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-induction]. If the total quotient can be resolved, then $Q(1,(\pi_0),\alpha,q)$ holds: the local problem after quotienting by the first eighth power can be resolved. The conclusion concerns only that quotient.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F8, proof

proof.text: Assume P(n) for n ≥ 1. (Case $r\ge2$, assuming $P(r-1)$.) Put $R'=R/\pi_1^8R$, $A'=A/\pi_1^8A$, $\Lambda'=\Lambda/\pi_1^8\Lambda$, $\mathfrak q'=\mathfrak q/\pi_1^8\Lambda$, a situation as in [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution] because a quotient of a Noetherian ring is Noetherian and finite presentation survives quotient tensor base change [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-quotient-base-change], and let $\pi'_1,\dots,\pi'_{r-1}\in R'$ be the images of $\pi_2,\dots,\pi_r$; they map into $\mathfrak q'$. Hypothesis (1) for $(R',\Lambda',\pi'_j)$, $j=1,\dots,r-1$: $R'/(\pi_1'^8,\dots,\pi_{j-1}'^8)R'=R/(\pi_1^8,\dots,\pi_j^8)R$ and $\Lambda'/(\pi_1'^8,\dots,\pi_{j-1}'^8)\Lambda'=\Lambda/(\pi_1^8,\dots,\pi_j^8)\Lambda$ (the third isomorphism theorem: both quotient maps kill precisely the ideal generated by the first j eighth powers), on which $\pi'_j$ acts as $\pi_{j+1}$, so this is hypothesis (1) of the lemma for $i=j+1$. Hypothesis (2): $\pi_{j+1}$ is strictly standard in $A$ over $R$, so its image $\pi_{j+1}\otimes1$ is strictly standard in $A\otimes_RR'\cong A'$ over $R'$ [lem-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-base-change] [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-quotient-base-change] (Stacks: 'property (2) is preserved by Lemma 07CC'). By the same third-isomorphism identification the reduction of $R'\to A'\to\Lambda'\supset\mathfrak q'$ modulo $(\pi_1'^8,\dots,\pi_{r-1}'^8)$ is isomorphic to $R/(\pi_1^8,\dots,\pi_r^8)R\to A/(\dots)A\to\Lambda/(\dots)\Lambda\supset\mathfrak q/(\dots)\Lambda$, which can be resolved by assumption. By $P(r-1)$, $R'\to A'\to\Lambda'\supset\mathfrak q'$ can be resolved, i.e. the reduction of $R\to A\to\Lambda\supset\mathfrak q$ modulo $\pi_1^8$ can be resolved.  This proves the claimed resolution of the first quotient.
